charts.title: HD 152843 c: orbits around HD 152843
charts.description: The orbits of HD 152843's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 152843 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Nicholson et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.532.4632N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NICHOLSON_ET_AL__2024): P 19.502104 d

charts.title: HD 152843 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 152843 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (25, 52, 79) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 349488688, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 14 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 26-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min early; 26-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
